features.quote: Stop an episode when one of these occurs: 1. Agent calls submit. 2. Agent explicitly gives up. 3. Agent reaches turn budget. 4. Agent exceeds token budget. 5. Agent repeats the same command/patch loop 3 times
Smoke eval: 8 agent turns; Standard eval: 16 agent turns; Stress eval: 32 agent turns
features.justification_quote: Use short horizons to keep cost low but long enough for repeated failure.

features.quote: Use heuristics as cheap monitoring, not final labels.
features.justification_quote: These are useful for triage and regression dashboards.
